scope: Preserve every entry of statements[] in each of the 400 captured DSLD labels, regardless of source type.
identity: Reuse existing snapshot/path/source-mapping assertion IDs and exact source evidence IDs. Never merge distinct source locations.
interpretation: A preserved label statement is an attributed manufacturer/source statement, not a verified medical fact or automatic warning. Keep type and text unchanged. Relevance is separately reviewed.
updates: Add only missing statement assertions, evidence and HAS_ASSERTION edges to the pinned navigation graph. Keep previous graphs and source files unchanged.
limits: Completeness refers to captured statements arrays, not label images, uncaptured products or clinical truth. Other original label fields follow the existing selected-field contract.
